posts.t: Varlamov with two big-time saves. Got to give him credit. He's rebounded. Pun intended. #Isles
Varlamov with an aggressive glove save early in the third. #Isles
Back for the third. #Isles down 2-1 but they've been on the attack for most of this game. See if they can bail out Varlamov and take this game in regulation.
#isles down 2-0 after 1. Have outshot LAK 14-6. Varlamov has allowed two goals he probably wants back.
Varlamov was completely off his angle. Rough start for him, as he's allowed two goals on 5 shots. #Isles

Kessel's point shot beats Kuemper -- he was square to shot -- but Anderson dives to keep the puck from going over the goal line.

Then, on the other end, Panarin scores his second of the game another tough one for Varlamov, from the low slot. 2-0 LAK.

Varlamov gives up a tough one as #GoKingsGo take a 1-0 lead with 14:09 to go in the first. Panarin shot, off an in-tight rush. Varlamov started sliding to his right but Panarin shot it glove side. #Isles
